authority: Source PNGs govern geometry. Values below are authored targets, not parameters measured from AI pixels or existing engine.
imageScalePolicy: Generated raster may be higher resolution; comparisons fit the full source aspect without crop. Preserve normalized geometry; no resizing/retouch via bitmap code.
gradeOrder: exposure gain once in linear RGB

definitions.exposureEV: Relative to frozen current engine reference E0; gain=2^EV. Not absolute camera EV or measured lux.
definitions.contrast: linear luminance contrast around .18 reference pivot, slope; clamp only at final tone mapper
definitions.saturation: linear gray-to-color mixing factor, 1 unchanged; percent=(factor-1)*100
definitions.warmth: authored diagonal RGB grade, red=1+warmthPercent/200, green=1, blue=1-warmthPercent/200; illustrative, not Kelvin or mired
definitions.shadowStrength: 1-shadowToLitLinearLuminanceRatio on neutral patch; achieved through direct/fill balance, not black overlay
definitions.shadowLength: Runtime L=height/tan(real solar elevation) and bearing=(solarAzimuth+180)%360. No real elevation/time/observer can be recovered uniquely from PNG.
definitions.crownColors: Shaded appearance swatches under fixture, not three albedo stripes painted onto lobes; use continuous normal/light occlusion and coherent neutral palette. Percentages report exact linear-luminance change relative to mid.

common.geometry: No relocations/additions/removals. Crown/trunk improvements bounded to existing silhouette and base clearance.

contact.combineRule: min(existingAOvisibility,newVisibility), not multiply; direct sunlight unaffected

trees.primaryExistingLobesPolicy: Preserve existing crown envelope and major group placement; subdivide smooth shading within lobes, no added tree positions.
trees.rootFlareRule: Only when visible/source clearance permits; do not widen into walk/road.

water.policy: Use current sky and solar source; no shoreline shifts, painted source stripe, planar/SSR mirror.

aerial.contextDetailFade: smoothstep from current detailed edge inward/outward only where same source data exists; blend material detail amplitude to coarse, never opacity erase buildings/roads/water
